scientific_integrity: An exact discrete-update conditional fixation-time theorem is proved from a finite-state embedded-chain argument and checked by independent labelled-state rational computations; the fixation-probability invariance is explicitly prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only the red-centre initial condition and properly two-coloured K_{1,l} with l>=2, matching fecundity r>0, and birth-death updates with counted null steps. Historical priority is provisional; no real-population calibration, and no independent review.
title: A sharp nonneutral speed optimum on every properly two-coloured Moran star
